Hi Walter,

Thanks for checking in. Here is where both of your open orders stand.

Shop····, the Magic Miner 40T with the Harlo OS Diagnostics plan, ships October 31, 2026. It is paid and reserved for you, and you will get tracking by email as soon as the label is made. You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Shop····, the NerdOctaxe 12TH/s from September 9, is the one I owe you an apology on. It is still waiting on stock at our US warehouse and there is no confirmed restock date on it yet, and we should have written to you about that before now. I will not invent a date for you. I have passed it to the team so they can confirm the real restock date for that unit. They are offline over the weekend and pick it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to this email address.

If you would rather not wait on the Octaxe, say the word and I can move that money to something we have on the shelf now, such as the Hammer Miner BC04 or the Thor P2, or I can have the team cancel and refund it in full. No fee either way since it has not shipped.

Sorry again for the silence on that one.

Sarah

Hi Walter,

Yes, that screen is correct, and I am sorry. The Magic Miner 40T batch is still being built at the factory, and the October 31 date on your Shop···· has now passed. I do not have a confirmed new date to give you, and I am not going to invent one after everything you have already been through on these two orders.

So I am not going to try to keep you waiting. I have asked the team to cancel both orders and refund you in full, with no fee of any kind, since nothing has shipped. That is Shop···· at $839.00 back to your PayPal, and Shop···· at $1,147.49 back through Afterpay, which is your original $348.49 plus the $475.00 you paid last month. They start at 10am Eastern this morning and will confirm the refunds to you in this thread. Once issued, the money typically shows in 3 to 5 business days depending on the provider.

I am sorry we did not get these units to you. You have been patient and reasonable throughout, and that is on us, not on you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Just to confirm,

The $839 is not PayPal, is an Amex that I used.

Walter V.

Hi Walter,

Thanks for the correction, noted. That $839.00 on Shop···· went through our Braintree gateway, which is where Amex payments land, so the gateway name on our side is just the processor and not PayPal itself. The refund goes straight back to the same Amex you paid with, not to a PayPal balance.

Shop···· refunds the same way, back through Afterpay, since that is how both the $348.49 and the $475.00 were taken.

Nothing has shipped on either order, so both refunds are full with no fee. The team starts at 10am Eastern this morning and will confirm each one here once issued. After that it is usually 3 to 5 business days for the money to appear, depending on Amex and Afterpay.

Sorry again that it ended this way.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
